goalTextActuallyRead.title: DNA, Gen und Chromosom als Informationsträger verknüpfen
goalTextActuallyRead.titleEn: Relate DNA, genes and chromosomes as information carriers
goalTextActuallyRead.description: Die lernende Person kann in einem einfachen Modell DNA als Material der Erbinformation, ein Gen als Abschnitt dieses Materials und ein Chromosom als organisierte Trägerstruktur unterscheiden und miteinander verknüpfen.
goalTextActuallyRead.descriptionEn: The learner can use a simple model to distinguish and relate DNA as the material of genetic information, a gene as a section of that material and a chromosome as an organised carrier structure.

referenceStrategy: Localized raster edit of v4 targeting single rod/inside zoom and longer bracket/halo. Actual geometry inspected again; prompt preservation instruction did not imply preservation.

entrance.finding: The rear helix curve emerges behind the smooth descending foreground near x470. The packed thread is a schematic change of magnification; individual molecular backbones within the chromosome/thread are not drawn or certified. No molecular fusion or branching is taught by this transition.

rungs.finding: Paired rods join opposite backbones; their shorter projected visible spans and occlusion near crossings fit the projected helix. Rod colors have no chemical-letter or base-pair assignment legend; no biochemical pairing claim is made.

chromosomeAndZoom.finding: One purple rod replaces the two-chromatid X. The magnification box is clearly inside the rod and dashed links select that area. It supports organised chromosome structure -> DNA material without introducing replicated-chromosome DNA-count ambiguity.

geneMarker.finding: The gold bracket and pale background halo select a substantial continuous middle DNA region over several paired rods. Unmarked DNA remains visible on both sides; highlight does not change or cut backbones. Stark verkürzt makes schematic shortening explicit. The actual span is about1.6 turns, not two; no real gene length, minimum base-pair count or two-turn claim is accepted.

scaleReadabilityStyle.finding: Actual360/680 views keep Chromosom, DNA, Gen and stark verkürzt readable and preserve the two-strand outline and marked segment. Friendly comic style, near16:9 native1672x941, strong contrast and ample spacing; no required fine print. Sizes, packing and gene span remain deliberately schematic.

preservationClaim.method: Independent view_image inspection of native and actual360/680 v5; both complete curves retraced. A read-only pixel comparison also confirms the new raster is not pixel-identical, so no exact-pixel preservation assertion is made.

goalScope: Image supports the simple DNA-material, gene-section and chromosome-carrier relation. Chemical structure,5/3 directionality, chromosome replication and exact gene dimensions are not demanded achievement evidence. Image does not replace learner evidence.
preservedFindings: Six country-view reviews and unchanged source/text/Memory/science findings remain separate at their existing bindings. V5 approval does not refresh D/P automatically.
